frontierDefinitions.frontier: Highest contiguous floor with at least one win; retries can change turn-order seed.
frontierDefinitions.reliableFrontier: Highest contiguous floor won under every sampled seed.
frontierDefinitions.majorityFrontier: Highest contiguous floor won under at least half of sampled seeds.
frontierDefinitions.floor100Wins: Direct summit samples, not proof that earlier floors were cleared.

limits: XR-ceiling includes an unavailable future character and is excluded from obtainable-party claims.
Ideal gems are supplied fixtures; acquisition time is not measured.
Sampled results are not human population win rates or an exhaustive optimal-build search.
Each previous floor needs at least one sampled win to count toward the retryable frontier. A direct summit probe does not establish reaching it.
Quality can change AI choices and action order; it need not strictly improve every individual seed.
